title: Logos 33 opening: Spirit God by nature from the Father
english: Thirty-third discourse. That the Spirit is God by nature and from the Father’s essence, supplied to creation through the Son.
“From God” of the Spirit is not leveled with “all things from God” so as to multiply gods.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
